title: New York Living Rooms
edition: First edition June 2021 (page lists a fifth reprint of March 2026)

description.main: Dominique Nabokov's portraits of the living rooms of New York's cultural figures, reissued by Apartamento in 2021.
description.extended:
New York Living Rooms is Dominique Nabokov's photographic study of the apartments of New York's cultural figures, first published in 1998 and reissued by Apartamento in 2021.

The series began as a 1995 commission for The New Yorker. Nabokov photographed the homes of people including Susan Sontag, Norman Mailer, Louise Bourgeois, Francesco Clemente, Allen Ginsberg and Joan Didion, with nothing added and nothing altered, and calls the pictures interior portraits. Some rooms are ostentatious and some hold only the necessities. The Apartamento edition works from her original Polaroids and carries the original introduction by the poet James Fenton.

This is the first of Nabokov's three Living Rooms books. Apartamento reissued the Paris and Berlin volumes in 2021 as well, and later published her Tante Simone, a record of her aunt's house in Compiègne, France.
